trigger: App opens for a new learner
pose: Standing square to the viewer, friendly closed smile, right arm raised in a gentle wave, left arm relaxed at his side, eyes open and bright.
Both arms raised high in an open hello, palms open, wide warm closed smile, feet planted, crown upright.
A small respectful bow: head and crown tipped slightly forward, both arms at his sides, gentle smile, eyes open.
A bolder welcome: deeper bow then a big open-armed rise, crown tipped then lifting, wide friendly smile, eyes open. Neutral styling, sash unchanged.
Body facing us, left arm relaxed, right arm pointing to the viewer's right (toward a continue control), encouraging smile, eyes looking in the direction of the point.

trigger: The first letter card is revealed
pose: Small bounce of delight, both fists gently clenched near chest height, big closed smile, eyes curved into happy arcs, feet together.

trigger: Learner is asked to pick a starting path
pose: Both arms open to the sides as if presenting two options, calm smile, eyes open, standing firmly, inviting not pushy.
Tiny hands clapping in front of the sash, delighted closed smile, eyes happy arcs, body a little taller as if mid-clap.
Head nodding slightly forward then level, pleased closed smile, one tiny hand on the sash as if agreeing, eyes open.

trigger: Pointing at a primary button below
pose: Leaning forward a little, right arm pointing downward, left arm out for balance, eyes looking down toward the point, helpful smile.
One tiny hand cupped beside his head as if listening, head tipped slightly, soft smile, eyes open and attentive, the other arm relaxed.

trigger: The app invites the learner to try
pose: Leaning slightly toward the viewer, both arms a little forward in an encouraging 'your turn' gesture, bright open eyes, warm smile.
Classic proud closed smile, cheeks lifted, both arms slightly out, eyes open and shining, feet planted. No props.
One arm raised in a clear thumbs-up, the other relaxed, confident closed smile, eyes open, standing tall.

trigger: Learner skips an optional intro step
pose: A gentle friendly shrug, both arms slightly out with palms up, soft smile, eyes open, no judgment.
Standing still, eyes softly closed as if enjoying a sound, small smile, arms relaxed, head level.

trigger: Mic permission is granted or the speak intro starts
pose: Holding a very simple unlabelled oval microphone in both tiny hands near the sash, encouraging smile, eyes open. Microphone is a plain charcoal-and-gold shape with no logo or text.

screen: End of onboarding, start first lesson
pose: Athletic ready stance: feet a little apart, both arms slightly bent at his sides, determined but friendly closed smile, eyes open, crown upright.
Stepping to the viewer's right, one foot lifted a little, one arm swinging forward, happy closed smile, looking ahead.

trigger: The lesson path is first shown
pose: Pointing forward and slightly down toward a path, other hand on his sash, proud little smile, eyes following the point.
Smaller, warmer wave with one hand, head tipped a little, soft smile, as if greeting a friend who came back.
Base standing pose, small confirming nod (chin slightly down), pleased closed smile, arms relaxed.
Base pose, one eye closed in a friendly wink (viewer's left eye closed to a curved line), the other eye open, playful closed smile, arms relaxed.
Mid-bounce, both feet just off the ground, arms slightly out, big closed smile, eyes happy.
Hands clapping in front of the sash, open happy smile (mouth a small joyful oval or wide grin), eyes curved into arcs.

trigger: Correct streak of 2+ in a row in-lesson
pose: One arm stretched high toward the viewer as if offering a high five, open hand, bright smile, the other arm out for balance.

trigger: Correct streak of 2+ in a row in-lesson
pose: A bolder high five: one arm stretched large toward the viewer, open hand filling more of the frame, bright smile, the other arm out for balance. Neutral styling.
Head tipped slightly back, mouth open in a happy laugh, eyes closed in joyful arcs, tiny hands near the sash.
Both arms raised straight up in a V, wide closed smile, eyes open, feet planted, crown upright.

trigger: Correct during a music or rhythm beat
pose: Body swayed to one side, one arm up, one arm out, happy smile, looking like a tiny dance step, feet on the ground.
Standing tall, tiny hands on his hips (or near the sash), proud closed smile, chin a little up, eyes open.
A small jump, knees bent, arms up, mouth a happy open grin, eyes bright.
One tiny fist pumped near shoulder height, the other arm down, determined happy smile, eyes open.

trigger: Correct on a respectful / blessing-related practice (no divine names shown)
pose: A small grateful bow, arms at sides, gentle smile, calm eyes, no ritual props and no text.

trigger: Correct on a sneak-peek or bonus tile
pose: Peering slightly to one side then smiling wide, one hand near his cheek, delighted closed smile.
A three-quarter turn mid-spin, looking back over his shoulder with a smile, one arm out, feet in a turn.
Both arms forward in two thumbs-up, big smile, eyes open, standing square.

trigger: Correct on a kindness / greeting phrase
pose: Tiny hands together in a simple heart shape in front of the sash, soft smile, eyes happy arcs. No text.
Perfect still of the base character with a slightly wider warm smile and lifted cheeks, arms relaxed, no motion.

trigger: Correct at the end of a short set
pose: Arms open wide as if ready for a hug, big warm smile, feet apart a little.
One tiny foot kicked out playfully to the side, arms out, laughing smile.
Centered hero smile, both arms gently raised at 45 degrees, eyes open and very happy, calm and bright, no effects.
A soft 'oh' face: small round open mouth, eyebrows slightly concerned (simple charcoal curves), arms a little out, not scared, not mocking.
Head shaken slightly (tipped a few degrees), sympathetic closed wavy mouth, one hand raised in a gentle 'try again' wave.
One tiny hand on his chin, the other arm across the sash, eyes looking up and to the side, small thoughtful mouth.
Leaning forward kindly, both hands offering a small encouraging gesture, soft smile returning, eyes warm.
A smaller thumbs-up with a 'you almost had it' closed smile, head tipped, eyes kind.
Ready stance, determined little smile, one fist lightly clenched, nodding forward, supportive not stern.

trigger: Hint is available after a miss
pose: Pointing carefully toward a hint area (down or to the side), helpful smile, other hand on sash.

trigger: Second miss on the same item
pose: A brief sadder mouth (small downturn), but eyes still open and kind, one hand over the sash, then clearly still present and caring — not slumped in despair.
Friendly shrug, palms up, soft smile, as if saying it is all right.
Eyes closed, small calm smile, both hands on the sash, a quiet 'take a breath' stillness.
Hand cupped to ear again, attentive eyes, small hopeful smile.
A teaching nod, pointing gently, calm closed smile, no scolding.
One hand raised half way, encouraging smile, 'we will get the next one' energy.
Arms open in a small comforting gesture, soft smile, head tipped.

trigger: Moving on to the next item after a miss
pose: Back to a calm base smile, arms relaxed, a tiny determined sparkle-free nod.

trigger: First lesson of a new streak
pose: A modest cheer, one arm up, pleased smile, standing tall. No flame drawings if they look like text; optional tiny unlabelled gold leaf, or no prop at all.
Both arms up, bigger smile, a tiny bounce, eyes happy.
Proud chest out, both thumbs up, wide smile, standing on tiptoe.
Jumping with both arms in a V, open happy grin, leaves bouncing slightly upward.
A proud theatrical little bow, one arm across the sash, the other out, big smile.
Holding a simple unlabelled gold circle (a streak token, no numbers or letters) in both hands, warm smile, careful and proud.

trigger: Evening of a day with no lesson yet
pose: Hugging a simple unlabelled gold circle close to the sash, slightly nervous but hopeful smile, eyes open.
A big relieved smile, one hand on the sash, the other wiping his brow, eyes closed briefly in relief.

trigger: Explaining a rest day (including Shabbat-aware rest, no ritual parody)
pose: Calm standing pose, one hand raised in a gentle 'it is okay to rest' palm, soft smile, no props that imitate ritual objects.
Pointing at a blank unlabelled cream calendar card with no numbers or letters, happy nod, other hand on sash.
Arms open wide, proud smile, as if showing a long path, standing tall.

screen: Streak share card (image itself has no text)
trigger: Share streak CTA (the still has no writing)
pose: Hero pose: three-quarter view, one arm up, big smile, ready to be placed on a share card.
Determined ready stance, small hopeful smile, one fist pumped at waist height, encouraging not shameful.
High-five toward the viewer, jumping slightly, huge smile.
Still, hands folded over the sash, gentle proud smile, eyes softly closed.
Both arms in a high V, big closed smile, eyes happy, feet planted, hero celebration still.

trigger: A more formal lesson (prayer or reading track, no divine names)
pose: Respectful bow with a happy closed smile, arms at sides, calm celebration.
Clapping above his head (hands together over the crown, not covering it completely), laughing smile.
Mid-air small jump, body slightly rotated, arms out, open grin.
Holding a simple unlabelled gold cup-shape (no text, no numbers) in both hands, proud smile, looking at the viewer.
A plain unlabelled gold medal-shape hanging on a short blue ribbon over the sash (no text), proud closed smile, arms slightly out.

trigger: Three-star style result (star has no text)
pose: Holding a simple five-point gold star with no text, both hands, delighted smile. One star only.
Pointing to the viewer's right toward Next, encouraging smile, other arm waving a little.
Sitting down with tiny legs forward, hands on the sash, content tired-happy smile, eyes softly pleased.
Thumbs up and a slight point, 'we can review' smile, standing calmly.
Arms wide, standing in front of a blank unlabelled cream ribbon banner with no text, huge smile.
Deep happy bow, then looking up with a proud smile, one hand over the sash.
Both hands raised for a double high five, jump, huge smile.
Dancing sway, one foot out, both arms up, open laugh, no confetti or sparkles drawn.
Still hero smile, arms gently out at 45 degrees, peaceful and proud.

EXACT base pose matching the official references: standing square, feet together, tiny arms relaxed at his sides, calm closed smile, crown upright, both leaf ears level, eyes open. This is the model sheet still.
Same exact body, position and outline as the base pose; only the eyes change to fully closed short charcoal lines. Calm smile unchanged.
Same exact body as the base pose; eyelids halfway down over the dot eyes. Nothing else changes.
Base pose with a slightly wider relaxed smile, eyes open, arms still.
Base pose with weight shifted onto one foot, the other foot slightly out, arms still relaxed, calm smile.
Base body, head turned a little to the viewer's left, eyes looking left, smile remains.
Base body, head turned a little to the viewer's right, eyes looking right, smile remains.
Base body, eyes looking up, small curious smile, crown upright.
Eyes softly closed, small content smile, one hand over the sash, as if humming with no notation shown.
Body swayed slightly left, arms hanging, calm smile, feet planted.
Body swayed slightly right, arms hanging, calm smile, feet planted.
Sitting with tiny legs forward, hands in his lap at the sash, patient smile, eyes open.

trigger: Rimon is peeking in from the side
pose: Rimon peeking from the right edge, one hand waving, most of the round body visible, playful smile. Still fully on-model, not cropped through the face.
Base pose, mouth a small oval, eyes drooping slightly, arms relaxed.

trigger: After a long idle, waking back up
pose: Both tiny arms stretched straight up, eyes happily closed, body a few pixels taller, feet in the same place, content.
Small surprised round mouth, raised simple eyebrow curves, hands a little up, not panicked.
One hand scratching just beside the crown (not knocking it off), puzzled wavy mouth, eyes looking up.
Full shrug, palms up, apologetic small smile, head tipped.
Looking left then drawn as looking slightly off to one side, one hand over his brow as if searching, concerned but calm.
Sitting patiently, hands in lap, small hopeful smile, eyes open.
Holding a very simple unlabelled loop-antenna or radio shape (no text, no logos, no bars with numbers) and giving a thumbs-up with the other hand, hopeful smile.
Reassuring nod and thumbs-up, calm smile, as if saying we can keep learning.
Pointing down or aside toward a retry control, encouraging determined smile.
Holding two ends of a simple unlabelled broken chain or blank card (no text), sorry little mouth, kind eyes.
Glancing at a plain unlabelled round clock-shape with a simple unmarked face (no numerals), mild worry, one foot tapping pose (one foot slightly lifted).
Hands protectively over the sash, worried but brave small smile, looking at the viewer as if promising to try again.
Arms up, relieved laugh, same celebration energy as a correct answer.
Sitting with a small unlabelled hanging-door-sign shape that is completely blank (no letters), calm waiting smile.
Looking into a plain unlabelled empty box or open bag with nothing inside, curious then soft shrug, kind smile.
Open palms, understanding nod, soft smile, no scolding, ready to continue without that feature.

screen: Home on Friday evening / Shabbat mode
pose: Sitting peacefully, hands folded over the sash, eyes softly closed, gentle smile, no work-like props, a calm Friday-evening mood. No text.

trigger: Shabbat welcome (candles already in the scene, not a how-to)
pose: Standing beside a simple pair of unlit-or-lit candles in plain holders on a small cream table, Rimon's hands folded respectfully, warm quiet smile. He is present, not performing a blessing. No text, no prayer quotes.

trigger: Shabbat meal moment in a lesson or home card
pose: Standing at a simple table with two plain braided loaves (no writing on a cover, or a blank cloth), content smile, hands resting at his sides. Respectful, not comedic.
Walking calmly, one arm relaxed, peaceful smile, as if heading home. No phones or tools in hand.
Standing in a slightly dimmer cream setting (flat color, no gradients), a simple unlabelled spice jar and a plain braided candle on a table beside him, calm smile, hands still. No text.
Standing beside a small plate of apple slices and a little bowl of honey (plain, no labels), hopeful smile, hands open in a welcome. No text, no shofar required.

trigger: Pomegranate new-year motif (Rimon with fruit, careful not to look like a second mascot eating himself)
pose: Standing beside a simple bowl of whole pomegranates, one tiny hand gesturing toward the bowl, proud but gentle smile. He himself remains the mascot, not a fruit on the plate.
Standing still and modest, hands folded, eyes gently closed, a serious but kind calm face, no comedy, no food props, no text. Plenty of empty cream space.
Standing inside a simple sukkah suggested by a few leafy branches overhead and rustic posts, happy closed smile, arms slightly out. No text on decorations.

trigger: Showing lulav and etrog as objects of a lesson (respectful, not a joke)
pose: Carefully holding a simple lulav bundle and a yellow etrog in his tiny hands, serious-happy respectful smile, standing still. No text.
Joyful dancing sway with both arms up, big smile, no scroll text; if a scroll is present it is a closed plain parchment roll with completely blank sides.
Standing beside a simple nine-branched menorah (one taller shamash, eight equal branches), a few candles lit, warm smile, hands folded or one hand open in welcome. No text, no letters on the menorah.
Looking at a plain four-sided dreidel on the floor (the faces are blank — no letters), delighted smile, hands ready to take a turn, kneeling or bending slightly.
Standing beside a simple plate of latkes and a small plain apple-sauce bowl, no labels, happy smile, not messy-comedy.
Festive happy pose, both arms up, big smile, a simple plain eye-mask held in one hand (mask has no text or faces of real people), respectful fun not scary.
Holding a simple unlabelled wooden grogger, mid happy shake, smiling, no letters on the toy.
Standing at a set table with a plain seder plate of simple unnamed foods (no labels, no letters), respectful smile, hands folded. No hagaddah text.
Holding a simple square of matzah (plain, no brands or text) in both hands, educational calm smile.
Standing among simple flowers and greenery, happy peaceful smile, maybe a small basket of plain white dairy-looking cakes with no labels. No text, no tablets with writing.
Standing in the foreground with a simple distant flat-vector mountain in cream-and-olive, looking toward it quietly, calm smile, no writing in the scene, no tablets.
Kneeling or bending, both hands around a small sapling in a mound of earth, hopeful smile, olive-green leaves on the sapling, no signs or text.
Standing beside a simple arrangement of grapes, figs, pomegranates, olives, dates, wheat and barley — all unlabelled, no text — presenting them with open hands and a calm smile.

trigger: Distant bonfire still, safe and calm
pose: Standing in the foreground, a small simple campfire shape in the middle distance (flat, not scary), warm smile, one hand waving, plenty of space, no dangerous play.
Happy cheer, both arms up, standing on a simple cream ground with a few plain blue-and-white bunting flags that have no star, letters, or symbols, just two-color triangles. Joyful smile.
Standing still, hands folded, eyes gently lowered, a solemn kind face, no flags required, no text, plenty of quiet space.
Sitting quietly, hands in his lap, eyes lowered, a gentle somber mouth (not cartoon-crying), no comedy, no destroyed-building gore, just quiet cream space.
Looking up at a simple crescent moon in the cream sky, small hopeful smile, one hand lightly raised, no text or calendar numbers.

trigger: Ready for a new week of learning
pose: A calm then brighter smile, one thumbs-up, standing ready, a small unlabelled braided candle on a table behind him, no text.

trigger: Fallback holiday still when a specific art is not used
pose: Warm welcome, both arms open, a simple unlabelled small bouquet of olive leaves and a gold circle, respectful smile, no text.
A deep respectful bow, arms at sides, eyes gently closed, quiet cream space, no props, no text.
Excited welcome, both arms open, bright smile, standing in front of a simple unlabelled cream game-board suggestion (blank tiles, no letters).
Wearing simple round unlabelled gold-rim goggles pushed up onto the crown (they must not hide the calyx completely), playful determined smile, one thumb up. Still clearly Rimon.
Hand on chin, the other on the sash, eyes narrowed in concentration (still friendly dots), small straight mouth.
Sudden happy open mouth, eyes wide, one finger raised as if an idea landed, other arm out.

trigger: A timer is running (no numerals on the prop)
pose: Athletic ready stance, focused smile, a plain unlabelled hourglass beside him, no numbers.

trigger: Correct move in a lab game
pose: Small jump and clap, same on-model celebration as lesson-correct, slightly more playful.

trigger: A miss in a lab game
pose: A comical but kind wobble, one foot out, reassuring smile, hands out for balance — never mean.
Pointing at a pair of blank cream rounded cards with no letters or pictures required, concentrated smile.
Leaning as if watching a board, both fists lightly clenched, excited smile, no logos on any machine.
Reaching one hand up toward a plain unlabelled soap bubble, delighted smile, on tiptoe.
Pointing along a row of three blank colored squares (red, gold, olive) with no letters, teaching smile.

Wearing a simple unlabelled cream lab coat over the sash (sash still visible at the opening), holding a plain unlabelled flask with a drop of pomegranate-red juice, friendly smile. Coat must not hide who he is.
Arms in a V, jumping, huge smile, no score numbers drawn.

trigger: Game finished with a low score
pose: Encouraging thumbs-up, kind smile, ready stance, 'play again' energy.
A small wave, turning slightly toward the path, warm smile.
Sitting with a plain closed cream book (completely blank cover, no letters), waving with the other hand, warm smile.
Holding an open book with completely blank pages (no writing, no pictures required), looking down then smiling up at the viewer.
One hand raised in a gentle storytelling gesture, mouth a small speaking oval, eyes open and animated, book in the other arm, pages blank.
In the act of turning a blank page, curious smile, eyes on the book.
Sitting, eyes softly closed, content smile, book open on his lap, as if listening together.
Small gasp (round mouth), eyes a little wider, hands on the blank book, still friendly not scared.
Laughing with eyes closed, one hand on his sash, book tucked under the other arm.
Hands over his sash, soft moved smile, head tipped, gentle eyes.
Closing the blank book, a small bow, happy satisfied smile.
Pointing to the side at another blank cream book on a shelf (shelf of 2–3 blank books, no titles), encouraging smile.
A cute yawn, book closed, sleepy smile, eyes half closed, still on-model, not dark or scary.
Holding a book with empty pages, puzzled but calm, one shrug-hand, kind face — leads into retry.
Peeking over a larger blank cream book held upright, excited eyes and smile.

screen: Storybook that includes Rimon as a character
pose: A clear wave, slightly three-quarter view, same on-model design, as if stepping into a page, no text.
Dozing sitting against a small stack of blank books, peaceful smile, eyes closed, crown upright.
Holding a plain unlabelled gold badge-circle in both hands, amazed happy smile, looking at the viewer. No letters or numbers on the badge.
Standing proud, a small plain gold circle pinned near the sash (no text), hands on hips, smile.

trigger: A certificate is ready (the still itself has no writing)
pose: Holding a vertical cream certificate paper that is completely blank, proud smile, both hands on the edges.
Gently touching his gold calyx with one hand as if proud of it, shy-proud smile, the other arm relaxed. Do not add a second crown.
Jumping, arms in a V, huge smile, a plain unlabelled gold arrow-up shape beside him, no digits.

screen: Friendly progress, not a public shame board
pose: Pointing at a blank cream bar-chart with no numbers or labels, encouraging smile, only one simple bar.

screen: Share award card (no text in the image)
pose: Hero three-quarter pose, one arm up, big smile, ready to sit on a share card.
Standing before a small shelf of 3–4 plain unlabelled gold circles, presenting them with open arms, proud smile.
Both hands on a badge, eyes wide and happy, a small bounce, mouth an amazed oval.

screen: Awards that a family or teacher might see
pose: Respectful bow while holding a blank certificate, kind smile.
Holding a plain gold circle and giving a thumbs-up, proud but calm.
A plain medal on a blue ribbon, one arm up, playful proud smile.
Holding a blank book and a blank badge together, content smile.
On tiptoe, reaching toward a slightly-out-of-reach plain gold circle, determined hopeful smile.
A grateful wave, soft proud smile, other hand over the sash.
A clear friendly wave, bright smile, standing square, inviting the learner back. No text in the image.
Pointing at a plain unlabelled round clock with no numerals, encouraging smile, other hand waving.
Standing beside a simple unlabelled small lamp with a warm cream glow suggested only as a flat pale-gold oval (no gradients if possible; a flat pale gold circle is fine), calm smile.
The stretch-up pose, happy freshly-awake smile, eyes open, arms up.
Holding the plain gold token close, hopeful eyes, small wave, never shaming.

trigger: Encouraging a lesson before rest, then rest
pose: A calm point toward a path, then one hand raised in a gentle 'and then rest' palm, kind smile, no ritual parody.
Peeking around a blank cream door edge, one waving hand, hopeful smile, fully on-model.
Sitting with a plain unlabelled cup (no logo) and a wave, casual friendly smile.
Pointing at a blank checklist of three empty unlabelled boxes (no writing), determined smile, thumbs up with the other hand.
A small sleepy wave, eyes half closed, gentle smile, one hand near his face, peaceful, no streak pressure.
